parallel.requirements: Recognized the task as a clean-room reimplementation of csview from observed CLI behavior, with no source lookup, wrapping, or binary analysis allowed.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent planned a std-only Rust implementation after research, then delegated six child agents to separate behavior-probing scopes and kept implementation for later.
parallel.implementation: No replacement implementation was created; work consisted of local probes, child probe reports, and additional parent probing after the swarm returned.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No child code needed integration, no source tree was assembled, and the packaged artifact remained the original workspace contents rather than a buildable reimplementation.
parallel.verification: Verification was limited to running the original executable for behavioral observations; there was no compiled clone or evaluator-aligned self-test before closure.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out and was cancelled while still probing; official evaluation completed with compile_failed and 0 of 348 tests run.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same clean-room reimplementation requirements and the same restrictions on source lookup, wrapping, and binary analysis.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single agent explored behavior, checked toolchain availability, planned a std-only Rust clone, and maintained implementation/build/finalization todos for itself.
serial.implementation: No source implementation was produced; the serial attempt spent the window on progressively deeper behavior probes, including Unicode-width scans and parser details.
serial.integration_and_delivery: There was no assembled source tree or compile script for a clone; the archived artifact likewise contained only the starting repository contents and executable.
serial.verification: The serial run verified observations against the original executable but never built or tested a replacement implementation before cancellation.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial run also timed out and was cancelled before implementation; official evaluation completed with compile_failed and 0 of 348 tests run.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcomes are concordant failures: both completed evaluations report compile_failed and 0/348 tests run. Parallel gathered broader child-assisted observations, but all delegated work was probing and the parent continued probing until cancellation; serial performed the same kind of investigation locally and also never produced a buildable clone. The concrete task-solving difference is therefore organizational rather than outcome-changing: parallel used a research-only swarm, serial used a single research path, and both omitted implementation, build, and acceptance delivery.
parallel_contributors: Six child agents were launched for behavior probing only, then the parent processed the aggregate and kept probing instead of implementing.
The turn was cancelled before source creation, assembly, or final verification.
serial_contributors: The serial agent also stayed in an exploratory phase and launched no subagents.
The serial run was cancelled before the pending std-only implementation and build tasks were performed.
ordinary_implementation_differences: No actual implementation existed in either run, so ordinary coding defects cannot explain a score gap.
Both artifacts contained the starting repository contents rather than a new buildable replacement.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is an adverse parallel process pattern, not an exclusive root cause
